subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Where should WebChat send-shortcut preference ownership live before the linked implementation lands?
rationale: Current repository policy treats new config/default and persisted preference surfaces as compatibility-sensitive, and current docs explicitly say WebChat has no persisted config section.

options.title: Use scoped Control UI settings
options.body: Add the shortcut mode to existing scoped `UiSettings` and chat settings UI while keeping plain Enter as the default.

options.title: Add gateway config surface
options.body: Introduce a documented canonical config/schema setting with upgrade and doctor expectations if operators need server-managed policy.

options.title: Decline configurable core behavior
options.body: Keep current Enter-to-send behavior and rely on existing Shift+Enter newline behavior if maintainers do not want another settings surface.

recommendation.title: Use scoped Control UI settings
recommendation.body: Add the shortcut mode to existing scoped `UiSettings` and chat settings UI while keeping plain Enter as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main composer ownership and the prior review context make this the strongest available routing signal for the product/settings-scope decision.
